gaps.reason: the source marks the ICD10CM diagnosis and active-problem value set not implemented with no codes; VAEN-R1 retains the implemented SNOMED branches

the source marks the gene-result value set not implemented with no codes, which also makes the generic organism-nucleic-acid branch inoperable; VAEN-R3 retains the implemented test-specific coded-positive and abnormal-interpretation branches

SEM_V1 has no numeric laboratory-result threshold predicate; the rules retain the source's coded Resistant Lab Result Value and resistant interpretation alternatives but cannot independently enforce MIC >=16 ug/mL in rules 4 and 6 or MIC >=2 ug/mL in rule 5

the source marks the E. gallinarum or E. casseliflavus/E. flavescens culture-test value set not implemented with no codes; VAEN-R5 retains both implemented generic-test alternatives with same-observation organism-specific results
the source identifies death-certificate VRE evidence, but SEM_V1 has no death-certificate evidence
